title: Bacterial Transformation Protocol
author: 宏亮 董
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7idhka6
materials: Plate 100 μl for a reaction product.

steps.title: Thaw Competent Bacteria
steps.instruction: Thaw DH5α chemically competent bacteria on ice for approximately 15 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Transformation Mixture
steps.instruction: Combine the competent bacteria with the DNA product and incubate on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 μl of DH5α chemically competent bacteria into 1.5 ml tubes.
Mix thoroughly with ligation product or digested product.

steps.title: Perform Heat Shock
steps.instruction: Subject the bacteria to a heat shock and then cool them.

substeps.instruction: Heat shock for exactly 45 s in a 42 ℃ water bath.
Place back on ice for 2 min.

steps.title: Outgrowth and Recovery
steps.instruction: Recover the bacteria in LB medium.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μl LB medium to each tube.
Shake the tubes at 37 ℃ and 200 rpm for 45 min.

steps.title: Concentrate Bacteria
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the bacteria and reduce the volume of the supernatant.

steps.title: Incubate Plates
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates upside down overnight at 37℃.
